correctness.rationale: The rank-three Fano matroid independence complex has 7 points, 21 edges, 28 independent triples (7 collinear triples removed). Every missing-line boundary is an integral sum of boundaries of present triangles coned to an off-line vertex, so boundary2 surjects the full K7 cycle lattice of rank 15; hence H1=0 over Z and H2 is free rank 28-15=13. Independently enumerated all 168 GL3(F2) maps, signed fixed simplices by element order, and verified H2 trace (13,-3,1,1,-1) for orders (1,2,3,4,7), with order7 split into equal classes; the standard PSL2(7) table decomposes it as V7+V3+conjugate(V3). Cyclic averages give fixed ranks (5,5,3,1) and full-group average zero. All these are correct finite/integral claims, but already published previously.
